description.value: TG-07-01 (PS-ENT-01): sectie Problemen heeft minimaal één entry.
TG-07-02 (PS-SEC-09): elke entry van sectie Problemen verwijst naar een Condition in het document.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.reference.distinct().subsetOf(%resource.entry.where(resource is Condition).select(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Condition/' + resource.id)))

description.value: TG-07-03 (PS-ENT-03): de Condition van de eerste entry conformeert aan http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-Condition.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Condition and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry[0].reference or fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry[0].reference or ('Condition/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry[0].reference)).resource

description.value: TG-07-05 (PS-ENT-05): elke Condition in sectie Problemen heeft code, subject, onset[x] en recordedDate.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Condition and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Condition/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(code.exists() and subject.exists() and onset.exists() and recordedDate.exists())

description.value: TG-07-10 (PS-NAR-02): de narrative van sectie Problemen noemt elk Condition (code.text of display).

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Condition and %resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).entry.reference.intersect(fullUrl | fullUrl.replaceMatches('^.*/(Condition/[^/]+)$', '$1') | ('Condition/' + resource.id)).exists()).resource.all(iif(code.text.exists(), code.text, code.coding.display.first()).all(%resource.entry.first().resource.section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).text.`div`.toString().contains($this)))
